name: Partner ETF Ownership Time-Series (Productionized)
description: Productionize a partner-by-ETF ownership time-series riding on the existing MDPF daily chain. The substrate data (etf_decomposition.held_by_partner x etf_total_net_assets) is already emitted by mdpf_aggregate_aua.py to s3://opal-data-portal-v2/platinum/mdpf/aggregate_aua/{date}.json. v1 adds (1) a derived ownership_pct field on the existing daily emit (additive minor methodology bump v0_9 -> v0_9_1), (2) a per-ticker time-series gold script writing s3://opal-data-portal-v2/platinum/mdpf/etf_ownership_timeseries/{ticker}.json with date-keyed series + MTD/YTD rollups, (3) trading-day-canonical NYSE/pandas_market_calendars binding with explicit coverage_fraction for partial-window partner onboards, (4) full-window-with-pre-onboard-zeros canonical headline + present-only + coverage-fraction audit fields. Scope v1: all current+future MDPF partners x the 4 Opal ETFs (DIVZ/IDVZ/PFDE/PFOE). Architecture decision Option A LEAN-EXTENSION-OF-MDPF-CHAIN selected per CTO judgment + DS recommendation; Andrew framing leaned Option B DEDICATED-RUNNER, surfaced as headline Andrew-ratification question Q1. Out of scope v1: other ETFs / sub-daily cadence / portal surface / dedicated EC2 / historical backfill (forward-only emit; historical backfill = separate follow-on TO if Andrew directs).
